_status: DRAFT FOR COMMUNITY REVIEW. This is not an authoritative or community-approved vocabulary. It is a small starter list so the Language Bridge can be built and tested. Curation owner: Member 4. In a real rollout BCCNS and community members would review every entry.
_how_it_works: If a query contains any term from a concept, the search also looks for every other term in that concept. Original record wording is never changed. 'historical' terms are used only to find records and trigger the content note; they are never suggested to users or used in AI-written text except inside quotes from a record.

concepts.label: Black / African Nova Scotian / African Canadian
concepts.note: Older catalogue descriptions often use 'Coloured' or 'Negro'. These terms are outdated and can be harmful. They are listed only so records described with them can still be found.
concepts.content_note: This record's original catalogue description uses historical terminology that is now considered outdated and may be harmful. The original wording is preserved because it is part of the historical record.

concepts.label: Africville
concepts.note: Variant place names that may appear in older descriptions. Verify each variant against source records before relying on it.

concepts.label: Black Loyalists
concepts.note: 'Book of Negroes' is the historical title of a specific record and is kept as a title, not as a descriptive term.
concepts.content_note: This record's original title or description uses historical terminology. The original wording is preserved because it is part of the historical record.

concepts.label: Relocation / displacement
concepts.note: Different catalogues describe the same events with different words.

concepts.label: Churches and congregations
concepts.note: Church records are a major source for community history.
